resources.string: Measuring was interrupted %1$d times this week
Android stopped Activity+ in the background. The status bar value and the history get gaps until you allow it once:
Battery → background power consumption → Activity+ → allow; turn on autostart; lock it in recent apps
App info → Battery saver → No restrictions; Autostart on
App info → Battery → Unrestricted; remove it from \"Sleeping apps\"
App info → Battery usage → allow background activity and auto launch
